provenance.contract: evidence/qbs04-endpoint-contract.md; exact ordered transcript labels, fixed share sizes, schedule infos and Finished roles.
provenance.implementation: Standalone Node crypto SHA-384/HMAC-SHA-384 and independent HKDF-SHA-384 extract/expand; no production imports.
provenance.secrets: ML-KEM and X25519 shared-secret inputs are fixed synthetic byte patterns for schedule arithmetic only; they are NOT real KEM/DH outputs or cryptographic agreement vectors.
provenance.proofs: Client/server proof envelopes are fixed synthetic bytes. Their SHA-384 commitments are transcript test inputs; envelopes are NOT valid COSE proofs and no signatures are verified.
provenance.authority: No peer pin, authority, consent, permission, endpoint state, installed key, traffic capability, or real transport is exercised.
provenance.digest_rule: Transcript digest = SHA384(ASCII QPR-TRANSCRIPT-PQ-1 || exact length-delimited ordered items); each item is u16be(label_len)||label||u32be(value_len)||value.
provenance.hkdf_rule: HKDF-SHA384: Extract(salt, IKM), then RFC 5869 Expand(PRK, exact ASCII info, 32 bytes). Finished MACs are HMAC-SHA384(finished_key, transcript_digest || existing role label).
